name: Sendero Laguna Los Pumas (Angostura sector)
note: Steep forest climb from the Lago Risopatrón campsites to Laguna Los Pumas, away from the Ventisquero Colgante crowds. Needs a CONAF ticket and the ranger house at Angostura is the contact; check hours (Tue–Sun, about 09:00–14:30). Roots and mud, so wear sturdy boots. Distance and ascent are estimates, so carry a GPS track.

name: Lago Verde to the km-13 plateau lakes (GPT28H start)
note: Out and back on the first part of the Lago Verde to La Tapera track through forest to a plateau with lakes. A stretch near km 6–10 needed landowner permission (not a problem for hikers in 2025), and fords are calf to knee. Remote, with mine trucks reported; carry water treatment and insect protection.

name: Lago Verde plateau camp (one night)
note: Tent version of the Lago Verde plateau walk, camping at a water point around km 13–22. Little wind shelter on the plateau and the same landowner and ford issues. Confirm conditions before going.

name: Sendero Chucao and beach, Puerto Raúl Marín Balmaceda
note: Flat coastal path through the fishing village to the sea, with a short side trail to the cemetery. Reached by about 70 km of gravel from La Junta; a good rest-day walk. Check the ferry to Puerto Cisnes if combining.
